messages:
meera_cs: Hey team — Opal Health accepted the sneakpeek kit. They're scheduled for a hands-on session next Tue. They mentioned the enablement guide link in the invite is still a WIP and it's making their engineers nervous. Also sales flagged a renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks; we should prioritize a smooth first experience. Can SE + PM help triage? assigning @jules_se + @amanda_pm

oliver_csm: Noted. Seat count is 10 (5 eng, 2 PM, 3 ops). Would love a one-sheet checklist for the session and a quick path to the minimal working demo.

jules_se: I can take docs. Drafting the integration walkthrough now — will push to Confluence today. Quickstart snippet for the hands-on:
```
# start local inference container
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/infer:local
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
I'll also prepare a 10m demo script and a short troubleshooting section. Link when live.

amanda_pm: I'll own feedback cadence. Proposal — 3 touchpoints: immediate micro-poll (1 question NPS-ish), 48h usability check, 2-week follow-up with 3 prioritized prompts to validate quality. I'll draft the Google Form + an in-product micro-survey. :thumbsup:

meera_cs: Great. Can we also add a renewal-risk tag on the account so CSMs get alerted? Sales said buyer cares a lot about integration speed.

jules_se: Will add a "fast-integration" checklist and a known-issues blurb. ETA EOD.

beta-bot: Calendar invite created: Opal Health hands-on — Tue 10:00am. Attendees: meera_cs, oliver_csm, jules_se, amanda_pm + Opal team.

oliver_csm: I'll prepare a one-page exec summary (ROI + risk mitigation) so buyer sees value quickly.

meera_cs: Action items: jules — docs + demo; amanda — survey + cadence; oliver — exec 1-pager; meera — renewal-tag & runbook. Dry-run sync 9:30 Tue.

amanda_pm: I'll include two quick prompts specifically to test latency and cost sensitivity.

jules_se: Quick Q — can we pre-provision a temporary dedicated session (higher throughput) to demo scaling? If yes I can demo an autoscale path.

meera_cs: Good call. I'll loop infra to request a temp dedicated instance. @infra-oncall?

oliver_csm: :eyes: If we spin up dedicated capacity, will that change the cost commitment we present? Sales needs a rough delta to include in the exec note.

meera_cs: I'll capture estimated delta and add to the exec one-pager.

amanda_pm: Sounds good. I'll coordinate the survey timing with the dry-run so we can ship the micro-poll right after the session. :thumbsup:

meera_cs: Thanks team — keeping this high priority. Ping me if docs aren't up by 5pm or if infra says no to the temp instance.
